proposals.evidence: DEDR399 includes Kodagu āṇï man/male and Tulu āṇů male, alongside Kannada āṇma/āṇba husband and Tamil āḷ husband. Pattapu ānɛ is proposed in this whole male/person family with its plain n and final ɛ retained. The husband sense is supported within the article, but this is not an exact same-form-and-sense attestation; local sound history and inheritance versus transmission remain subject to review. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: Proposed ordered components: front795 plus chest/breast4818. DEDR795 gives Telugu/Tulu eduru front/forepart;4818 gives Malayalam māṟu chest and Tamil mār breast/chest. These account for both portions of Pattapu ed̪uɹumāɹu with its dental and rhotic notation preserved. This is an analyst-proposed composition, not a claim that DEDR attests the full Pattapu compound or that mixing quoted comparanda establishes a donor language. The separate simple breast mola record remains distinct.
